Desc: Our search for the immaculate espresso began when we were embraced by the warm welcome of Ramdev and his parents Shantha and Nagesh as we drove through the gates of Bettadamalali Estate in early 2023. A pristine farm nestled in the Baba Budan Giri hills of Chikmagalur, this place is more than a commercial operation – it is a garden of nature’s best delights. With scientific approaches to farming complemented by highly structured operations, Bettadamalali produce some of the best washed Arabicas we have encountered in recent times. The farm has been a long-term partner to our sister enterprise Indcaffe – who have over the years exported several hundreds of tons of washed Arabica for them to specialty houses in Europe. We decided to grab our own little share of the treasure as we cycled through multiple lots to find this gem that would help us curate a delicious espresso.

Desc: Our first lot from BEWILD Coffee is an anoxic-fermented Fine Robusta from Poomaale Estate. This unique and complex wild-harvested canephora coffee embodies the essence of its origin. It is a testament to nature's resilience and the power of regenerative agriculture. BEWILD have worked closely with a team of growers, roasters, and brewers to cultivate this coffee in a sustainable and ethical way, embracing the principles of permaculture and biodiversity conservation. The result is a distinct coffee experience that celebrates the wildness of the forest and the magic of nature.

Desc: Unakki Dark Honey is a testament to our enduring partnership with producer Utsav Gowda of Unakki Estate. Following the success of Unakki's washed lot, a bestseller celebrated by our customers for its clean, consistent, and classic flavor profile, Utsav continues to refine his processing techniques. This year, he presents us with a remarkable Dark Honey, meticulously curated for optimal performance in espresso. This release reinforces our commitment to fostering a long-term relationship with Unakki Estate, ensuring a future of extraordinary coffees for our community.
